vibe_rationale: Genuine bass-music scene with a 15-year history and a camping community, but a party-first New Year format rather than a curated culture.
fit_notes: Adult-only (18+) camping crowd where a recovery, rest or hydration space has an obvious job, but no sponsor roster or partnership route is in the record. The 2025/26 edition was scaled back to about 6,000, so reach is shrinking; it is a New Zealand event.
